case_title: SANDRA ZAMORA GOMEZ VS. LILIAN EDITH FIERROS

docket_entries.description: MONEY CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF FOR $2,654.66 FILED BY ZAMORA GOMEZ, SANDRA AS TO DEFENDANT FIERROS, LILIAN EDITH ORDER SETTING TRIAL ISSUED FOR OCT-03-2022 AT 06:30 PM IN DEPT 506
SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF OCT-03-2022 - CONTINUED THE COURT'S OWN MOTION AND AGREED BY PLAINTIFF TO DEC-05-2022 AT 5:30 PM IN DEPT. 506.

SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF DEC-05-2022 - CONTINUED FOR PROOF OF SERVICE TO MAR-06-2023 AT 5:30 PM IN DEPT. 506. NO APPEARANCES ARE MADE. PER JUDGE TONG'S INSTRUCTIONS, PLAINTIFF WAS CALLED ON 12-1-22 TO INQUIRE AS HER APPEARING ON MONDAY 12-5-23 AND DISCUSSED THE ISSUE OF NOT HAVING FILED A PROOF OF SERVICE ON HER CLAIM. PLAINTIFF STATES THAT SHE HAS NOT BEEN ABLE TO SERVE DEFENDANT AND REQUESTED A CONTINUANCE. MATTER CONTINUED TO 3-6-23 AT 5:30 P.M. JUDGE: MICHELLE TONG; CLERK: W. TRUPEK. NOT REPORTED. (506)
ORDER OF CONTINUANCE FOR PROOF OF SERVICE.
THE COURT ORDERS DISMISSAL OF THE ENTIRE ACTION WITHOUT PREJUDICE. NO APPEARANCES BY PLAINTIFF. NO APPEARANCES BY DEFENDANT. JUDGEPROTEM: PANG LY; DEPUTY RON. CLERK: D. AU. NOT REPORTED.(D506)
ORDER CASE DISMISSED WITHOUT PREJUDICE (SEE SCANNED DOCUMENT FOR DETAILS.)
